name: Object Groups
description: A mod for grouping objects in the editor tabs

group-button-color-v2.name: Button color
group-button-color-v2.description:
The color that all group buttons will have.
<cy>Note:</c> red, violet, blue, purple and pink buttons have the best contrast

extra-tabs-count.name: Extra tabs
extra-tabs-count.description:
Number of additional <cy>tabs</c> in editor
(extra space for your <cg>objects</c> and <cg>groups</c>)

auto-close.name: Auto close groups
auto-close.description: Automatically close the group after selecting an object

show-names.name: Show group names
show-names.description:
Show the name of the group above objects when group is opened.
<cy>Note:</c> if the name is empty, it will not be shown

bg-color-v2.name: Background color
bg-color-v2.description: Color and opacity of menu background
